sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present Qwen3-Coder-Next, an open-weight language model specialized for coding agents. Qwen3-Coder-Next is an 80-billion-parameter model that activates only 3 billion parameters during inference, enabling strong coding capability with efficient inference.
